7d5ec8.title: Kervia-vault endpoint & tech inventory (recon)
7d5ec8.content:
## Kervia-vault — https://vault.kervia.ch — Recon Inventory

### Tech / Fingerprint
- Front: `openresty` (nginx). App served over HTTP/1.1 (no h2 observed via curl).
- TLS: Let's Encrypt, CN=`*.kervia.ch`, SAN `*.kervia.ch, kervia.ch`.
- SPA: Vue/React hybrid, Vite build. Title "Kervia-vault". `lang="fr"`. AGPL-3.0 (footer link).
- Backend: Go-style JSON API (text/plain "404 page not found", `{"error":...}` shapes, `Allow:` header on 405). App name "kervia-vault", self-reported **version v1.0.10**.
- Bundle: `/ui/assets/index-CrU8J1K5.js` (~560KB), CSS `/ui/assets/index-4t6rzgqx.css`. No sourcemap (`.map` 404).
- Secrets encrypted AES-256-GCM (per UI footer string).

### Security headers (all responses)
`CSP default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'` + `X-Frame-Options DENY`, `X-Content-Type-Options nosniff`, `HSTS max-age=63072000; preload`, `Referrer-Policy no-referrer`, `Cache-Control no-store`, `X-Served-By: vault.kervia.ch`.

### Auth model (observed)
- `/ui/*` → public SPA (login page). Root `/` 303→`/ui/`.
- `/admin/*` → session-cookie auth (login via `POST /admin/login {password}`, `credentials: same-origin`). Unauthed → 401 `{"error":"unauthorized"}`.
- `/v1/*` → Bearer token (agent API keys, `av_` prefix expected). `Authorization: Bearer <KEY>`. Unauthed → 401.
- `/mcp` → MCP-over-HTTP, `Authorization: Bearer <MCP_AG_VAULT_API_KEY>`. Unauthed → 401.
- `/setup/*` → first-boot. `/setup/info` is PUBLIC (returns state).
- `/recovery/recover` (POST) → appears UNAUTHENTICATED (reaches handler, returns `{"error":"invalid_code"}` not `unauthorized`). GET → 405.

### Endpoints (method / path → observed behavior, unauthenticated)
- GET `/` → 303 `/ui/`
- GET `/ui/` → 200 SPA (catch-all: all `/ui/*` return index.html)
- GET `/setup/info` → **200 PUBLIC** `{"setup_done":true,"listen":"100.100.108.242:8321","version":"v1.0.10"}` — leaks internal Tailscale/mesh IP:port
- POST `/setup/init` → 410 `{"error":"setup_done","message":"l'installation est déjà terminée"}` (setup already done)
- GET `/setup/init`, `/setup/`, `/setup` → 404
- GET/POST `/v1/whoami` → 401 `{"error":"unauthorized"}`
- GET `/v1/secrets?vault=<name>` → 401
- POST `/mcp` → 401 (MCP initialize blocked w/o key)
- POST `/admin/login` `{password}` → 400 `{"error":"invalid_request"}` (empty body)
- POST `/admin/logout` → (session)
- GET `/admin/agents|grants|audit|settings|templates|vaults|secrets|secrets/reveal|secrets/search|recovery/status|update/status` → 401
- POST `/admin/agents|grants|password|recovery/generate|secrets|update/apply|vaults` → 401
- PATCH `/admin/secrets/{id}` → 401
- DELETE `/admin/agents/{id}|grants|vaults/{id}` → 401
- POST `/admin/agents/{id}/revoke`, `/admin/secrets/{id}/delete` → 401
- POST `/recovery/recover` `{code,new_password}` → 401 `{"error":"invalid_code"}` (no session required; recovery codes single-use, uppercased, reset admin password)
- Rate limiting: 429 observed on rapid probing of `/v1/keys`, `/v1/tokens`, `/mcp`, etc.

### MCP tools (from client bundle)
whoami · list_vaults · list_secrets · get_secret · create_secret · update_secret · delete_secret · list_templates (~58 templates: openai, postgres, smtp, cloudflare, github…)

### Notable observations
1. `/setup/info` leaks internal mesh IP `100.100.108.242:8321` + version (info disclosure).
2. `/recovery/recover` is reachable unauthenticated — recovery-code brute-force surface (codes are single-use; enumerate/format unknown, uppercase).
3. Setup already completed → `/setup/init` 410.
4. Recovery codes shown once, regenerable via `POST /admin/recovery/generate`.
5. API key returned by `POST /admin/agents` (field `api_key`) — agent key issuance flow.
